subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path display mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and changing it affects user-facing display defaults across multiple surfaces, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Change user-facing agent/tool path output to full absolute paths by default and update prompts, docs, and tests consistently.

options.title: Add Explicit Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep current defaults but add a documented opt-in setting for users who need absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is repeated work on tool display and shared path utilities, and this decision is primarily a product/display contract choice.
